pairs.why: Near-identical pair, but B's smooth, softly lit red handle matches the soft clay-plastic finish of the real cards better than A's ridged, glossier grip.
A's simple smooth handle and softer highlights read like the real cards' rounded toy finish, while B's segmented grip adds busier detail.
B has a smooth rounded handle and a lens that softly shows the ring background, closer to the real cards' clean, simple build than A's ridged handle.
A's smooth handle and soft lens with the background showing through match the real cards' simple shapes better than B's ridged, slightly glossier grip.
Both have ridged handles, and B's slightly softer lens and gentler highlights lean a little more toward the real cards' satin finish.
Almost identical, but B's lens and rim are a touch less mirror-glossy, closer to the soft real cards.
Both are very close, and B's handle sheen and rim shading are slightly softer and less statue-glossy than A's.
